datasets.role: line survey, regions, moment maps, wings

recipe.description: Line list: Splatalogue (CDMS+JPL) via astroquery for the rest ranges 164.4-179.8, 251.2-268.1, 341.9-357.3 GHz, curated species + hydrogen RRLs from the Rydberg formula
Continuum survey of all 2D pbcor images: peaks >5 sigma, positions, rms (MAD)
Spectra extraction from all pbcor cubes: N, S nominal pixels, beam aperture (diameter = geometric-mean FWHM), r=2.5" and r=8" flux densities, cube-peak pixel
Systemic velocity from HCN/HCO+ first moments and half-maximum midpoints
Blind boxcar scan (300 and 100 km/s) at 5 sigma, forced photometry of all catalogue lines, overview and zoom plots; identification at |dv|<60 km/s with plausibility tiers
Moment maps (core |v|<350, blue -400..-150, red 150..400 km/s, mom1 3-sigma clipped), peak finding (>8 sigma, >=1 beam apart) to define regions

Region spectra (peak pixel within 0.6" of the nominal position, beam aperture), 1- and 2-Gaussian fits (scipy curve_fit, constant baseline, noise from line-free channels, lag-1 correlation inflation), integrated intensity |v|<350 with empirical box-sum noise, Tb (Rayleigh-Jeans)
Weak lines by matched filter with same-region HCN/HCO+ templates (limits 3 sigma); CS/H2CS/29SiO NNLS blend model; H13CN on CO wing

interpretation: The survey finds that the spectral content of the dataset is dominated by only a handful of lines: HCN and HCO+ 2-1/3-2/4-3 (very high S/N at both nuclei), CS 7-6 (N 15 sigma, S 7.5 sigma, Xb47), a CH3OH J_-1-J_0 E blend in Band 5, and the blue wing of CO 3-2 at the Xb47 spw20 edge. Everything else (SO 5_6-4_5, 253.97 GHz bump, HC3N 28-27, HC15N, SO 8_8-7_7, HCN-vib, H13CN) is absent or only marginal, so shock/chemistry diagnostics beyond CS, HCN/HCO+ ratios and CH3OH will be limits (Q4, Q5). The proposal's SO(6_5-5_4) is not in the data. The system is resolved at 0.25-1": N (double-horned, broad, extended continuum), S (compact continuum, line centre ~65 km/s blueward of systemic, narrower), a narrow Bridge component 1.4" S of N, two eastern clumps (E1, E2, redshifted 50-90 km/s), a western clump, and a blue-shifted blob (Sblue) 3" S-SW of S with a broad (120-230 km/s) blue-shifted profile and a blue wing; the S nucleus itself has a 4-9% blue wing. These match the picture of a dense-gas outflow near the S nucleus, but the high-velocity channels are outside the clean mask, so wing fluxes are lower limits/dirty. N and S are cleanly separable at Bands 6-7 (beam minor axes 2.7-3.5" << 5.2") and only partially in Band 5. HCN/HCO+ at matched J is already a regional discriminator (N 0.6-1.0, S 0.4-0.5 at J=3-2); this is handed to Q1 together with matched-beam convolution. The delivered mfs/cont images are line-free.
caveats: Formal errors only; channel noise is correlated (lag-1 rho ~0.1-0.5), approximately corrected; no flux-scale uncertainty (10% typical) and no primary-beam model check (pbcor correctness at region E1 ~7" from phase centre, pb~0.7 in Band 6, not verified).

Double-horned profiles at N: single-Gaussian fits are poor (chi2r up to 20); use the 2G or integrated numbers. Gaussian centroids at S differ between beams (2764 at 5.7" vs 2710 at 0.25") because the beam mixes components.

High-velocity wings are outside the pipeline clean mask (0-7% of wing channels masked): wing fluxes are uncleaned and may be biased; the Sblue structure and S blue wing need confirmation (e.g. in the manual/tapered cubes, Q2/Q8).
Peak-pixel regions are defined on HCO+ 3-2 moment maps of Xb4d; apertures for E1/E2/W/Sblue/Bridge exist only for the 1" and 0.25" arrays, lower resolution cubes blend them into N/S.

Line IDs are from the Splatalogue rest frequencies at one systemic velocity; blends with line separation < line width (HCN v2=1, CS/H2CS/29SiO, CH3OH series, H13CN/CO) cannot be resolved with the data; the NS assignment of the 253.97 GHz bump is disfavoured but no alternative simple species fits.
Weak-line limits use the HCN/HCO+ profile of the same region as template; real profiles of other species may differ (narrower => limit in Jy/beam km/s is conservative).
Distance 40 Mpc (Pereira-Santaella+2024), literature only; not measured here.

CO 3-2 is only partially covered; its wing amplitude depends on the band edge and no CO baseline exists, so H13CN opacity (Q4) cannot be constrained in this file; confirmation would need data covering 345.3-345.8 GHz rest.
